summary: Mission evaluation no longer queries, parses and folds the entire timing history of inactive steps without timeouts; active steps, timed steps and public views retain full clocks

replay.detail: Evaluation read optimization only; canonical replay and persisted projections are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Public presentation and reconcile views are unchanged. Internal evaluation views omit unused timing fields only when a known definition has no timeout and the effective step is neither claimed nor working. Active untimed steps retain declared-wait deadlines for the incremental scheduler. Missing definitions retain full timing.

downtime.detail: No downtime or operator intervention required.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit; no data migration.
